stories.title: Saudi camel trading rules protect buyers, animals

en.title: Saudi camel trading rules protect buyers, animals
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture approved nationwide camel trading rules to protect buyers and owners while promoting animal welfare. The rules establish requirements for sales, leasing, exchanges, ownership records, and animal health standards.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia condemns Israeli officials, settlers for storming Al-Aqsa Mosque

en.title: Saudi Arabia condemns Israeli officials, settlers for storming Al-Aqsa Mosque
en.summary: Saudi Arabia condemned Israeli officials and settlers for what it described as provocative practices at Al-Aqsa Mosque, following an incident where Israeli authorities closed one gate after 1,731 settlers entered the compound.

stories.title: السعودية تطلق «الباقة الشاملة» الإلكترونية لخدمة حجاج الخارج

en.title: Saudi Arabia launches comprehensive "package" electronic service for foreign pilgrims
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Hajj and Umrah launched a comprehensive electronic package service for foreign pilgrims for the 1448 Hijri season.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia strongly condemns continued Israeli provocative actions against Al-Aqsa Mosque

en.title: Saudi Arabia strongly condemns continued Israeli provocative actions against Al-Aqsa Mosque
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Foreign Affairs strongly condemned Israeli provocative actions and extremist settler activities at Al-Aqsa Mosque, rejecting what it characterized as violations of international law.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia approves new regulations for camel trading

en.title: Saudi Arabia approves new regulations for camel trading
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture has established new regulations for camel trading activities including sales, purchases, rentals and exchanges. The framework aims to develop industry practices, protect rights of participants, strengthen the livestock sector and improve animal welfare standards.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia resumes oil exports via East-West Pipeline after repairs

en.title: Saudi Arabia resumes oil exports via East-West Pipeline after repairs
en.summary: Saudi Arabia has restarted oil shipments through its East-West Pipeline following completion of repairs from September drone strikes. The restoration of this export route provides an alternative channel as the Kingdom also increases crude exports through the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia: a window into the future of treasury in Middle East

en.title: Saudi Arabia: a window into the future of treasury in Middle East
en.summary: Saudi Arabia serves as a model for treasury transformation in the Middle East, with its advancing digital payments ecosystem reshaping how businesses handle cash management and liquidity. The Kingdom's expanding international corporate presence demonstrates emerging trends in regional financial practices.

stories.title: Saudi foreign minister arrives in Washington for official visit

en.title: Saudi foreign minister arrives in Washington for official visit
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Foreign Minister Prince Faisal bin Farhan has arrived in Washington for official discussions with U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio. The visit will cover bilateral relations and current regional and international matters.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia condemns terrorist attack on security checkpoint in Pakistan

en.title: Saudi Arabia condemns terrorist attack on security checkpoint in Pakistan
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Foreign Affairs issued a statement strongly condemning a terrorist attack on a security checkpoint in Pakistan's Dera Ismail Khan region that resulted in multiple fatalities. The Kingdom expressed solidarity with Pakistan and reaffirmed its opposition to all forms of terrorism and extremism.

stories.title: Syria expects over $1bn in foreign capital for new banks, central bank governor says

en.title: Syria expects over $1bn in foreign capital for new banks, central bank governor says
en.summary: Syria's central bank governor stated the country anticipates foreign investment exceeding $1 billion for establishing new banks as part of efforts to strengthen the banking sector. The initiative aims to encourage investment, protect customer rights, and establish secure transfer channels.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia Condemns Terrorist Attack in Dera Ismail Khan, Reaffirms Support for Pakistan

en.title: Saudi Arabia Condemns Terrorist Attack in Dera Ismail Khan, Reaffirms Support for Pakistan
en.summary: Saudi Arabia condemned a terrorist attack targeting a security checkpoint in Dera Ismail Khan in northwestern Pakistan that resulted in casualties. The country reaffirmed its support for Pakistan.

stories.title: ‘Any attack on Saudi Arabia is an attack on Morocco,’ King Mohammed VI says

en.title: 'Any attack on Saudi Arabia is an attack on Morocco,' King Mohammed VI says
en.summary: Morocco's King Mohammed VI expressed solidarity with Saudi Arabia, stating that attacks on the Kingdom are attacks on Morocco. He condemned Houthi strikes against the country and reaffirmed Morocco's support for Saudi security.

en.title: Tadawul announces Q3 2026 index maintenance
en.summary: The Saudi Exchange announced updates to free-float shares for listed companies effective October 4. Several companies including Chemanol, Armah Sports, Ladun Investment, and Amwaj International were added to various indices on the Main Market and Nomu-Parallel Market.

en.title: Tadawul: Major ownership changes on Sept. 24
en.summary: The Saudi Exchange reported significant ownership structure changes among listed companies effective September 24.

stories.title: ‎111 securities may be subject to CMA algorithmic trading controls

en.title: 111 securities may be subject to CMA algorithmic trading controls
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Capital Market Authority has drafted rules for algorithmic trading that would apply differently based on liquidity levels, with the most liquid securities exempt from proposed restrictions on algorithmic order ratios.

stories.title: ‎Economic recovery depends on easing trade restrictions: Jadwa Investment

en.title: Economic recovery depends on easing trade restrictions: Jadwa Investment
en.summary: An investment firm projects lower oil-related GDP in the near term and expects third-quarter GDP decline, though higher oil prices have offset reduced export volumes and are expected to boost nominal GDP and government oil revenues.

stories.title: ‎Arabian Cement finalizes exit, share swap deal for Jordanian equity

en.title: Arabian Cement finalizes exit, share swap deal for Jordanian equity
en.summary: Arabian Cement completed its subsidiary's exit from a concrete company and acquired stakes in a Jordan-based cement company, generating a capital gain of 18.9 million Saudi riyals from the transaction.
